newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - NIKE cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - NIKE cut to hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Shelly Hale Young cut her rating on athletic footweare maker NIKE Inc to hold from buy based on weakness in U.S. markets.
-- In a statement, she said domestic footwear sales are slowing more rapidly than expected, and retail sell-through in March and April has been weaker than forecast.
-- She cut her fiscal fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.68 a share on $2.5 billion in sales, from $0.74 a share on $2.6 billion in sales.
-- She reduced her fiscal 1998 estimates to $3.40 a share on $11.1 billion in sales, from $3.52 a share on $11.3 billion in sales.
